hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))"); case "$f" in */backend/*.py) root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}"; "$root/backend/.venv/bin/ruff" check --fix "$f"; "$root/backend/.venv/bin/ruff" format "$f" ;; esac; true
hooks.statusMessage: Running ruff check --fix + format on edited Python file

hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))"); case "$f" in */frontend/*.ts|*/frontend/*.tsx) root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}"; "$root/frontend/node_modules/.bin/eslint" --fix "$f" ;; esac; true
hooks.statusMessage: Running eslint --fix on edited TS/TSX file
